name: Pacifist (Major)
description:
Unless the android is designed for combar, most advanced societies require the installation of 'Asimov Circuits', a concept based on science fiction writer Isaac Asimov's 'First Law of Robotics.'
The artificial being may not injure a sapient being, or through action or inaction, allow such a being to be harmed. This gives them the Pacifist (Major) Hindrance.
